name: The Burgomaster's Burial
summary: Kolyan Indirovich, burgomaster of the village of Barovia, died three nights ago. His children want him buried in the churchyard, and no villager will help carry the coffin.

stages.journal: Ismark Kolyanovich asked us to help bury his father, the burgomaster. The body lies in the family mansion; the village is too frightened to carry it to the church.
stages.hint: Go to the burgomaster's mansion on the village's north side and talk to Ireena.

stages.journal: Ireena won't leave her father unburied, and she wants the rites said properly. Father Donavich keeps the church on the hill at the north-east edge of the village.
objectives: Ask Father Donavich to say the rites
stages.hint: Father Donavich is in the church on the hill at the village's north-east edge. Ask him if he'll bury the burgomaster.

stages.journal: Father Donavich has agreed to say the rites over the burgomaster. All that's left is to carry the coffin from the mansion to the churchyard.
objectives: Tell Ireena or Ismark you're ready
Carry the coffin to the churchyard
stages.hint: Go back to the mansion and tell Ireena or Ismark you're ready to carry the coffin.

stages.journal: Father Donavich won't say the rites. If the burgomaster is to be buried, someone else will have to find the words, or do without them.
objectives: Tell Ireena or Ismark you're ready
Carry the coffin to the churchyard
stages.hint: Go back to the mansion and tell Ireena or Ismark you're ready; you'll have to say the words yourselves.

stages.journal: The coffin has left the mansion. The grave is dug in the churchyard, beside the burgomaster's wife.
stages.hint: Go to the open grave in the churchyard behind the village church and talk to Ireena or Ismark there.

stages.journal: Kolyan Indirovich lies in the churchyard. Whatever was said over him, the earth has him now, and the devil doesn't.
